title: Configure a preload file
summary: A preload script runs before the page and can expose a small API.
introduction: A preload script runs before the page and can expose a small API. Your task: Find the path joined to __dirname.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for configure a preload file

blocks.text: A preload script runs before the page and can expose a small API. Its file path belongs in the BrowserWindow options.

Use a local Electron project with electron installed as a dev dependency and main.cjs as its main file. Run with npx electron . after creating package.json and index.html. These APIs do not run in a web-page playground.

blocks.title: Configure a preload file

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `contextIsolation: true` separates preload context from page script context. Keep `nodeIntegration` off for the renderer.
`join` creates, updates and removes selected elements to match the bound data.

blocks.text: The named local preload file is loaded for that window before page scripts.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use an absolute preload path. Do not let the page choose which preload file to run.
